name: OneNote (Microsoft 365)
description: Let your AI work in OneNote: browse notebooks, sections and pages, read pages, create notebooks, sections and pages, and add notes to existing pages. OneNote for work or school and personal OneNote through Microsoft Graph, signed in with your Microsoft account.
instructions:
## OneNote This connector works with the signed-in user's OneNote notebooks through **Microsoft Graph v1.0** (`https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0`, `/me/onenote`): browse notebooks, section groups, sections and pages, read pages, create notebooks, sections and pages, and add to or change existing pages. It works with OneNote for work or school (Microsoft 365) and with personal OneNote. Everything runs as the user who authorized the connector: the AI sees and changes exactly what that user can. **Setup (one-time, about 10 minutes)** 1. Open https://entra.microsoft.com (or https://portal.azure.com) → **Applications → App registrations → New registration**. 2. Name it (e.g. "AnythingMCP Microsoft 365") and choose the **supported account types**: - *Accounts in this organizational directory only* (single tenant): only your organisation's users can sign in. Set `MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID` to the **Directory (tenant) ID** shown on the app's Overview page (a GUID), or to your domain such as `contoso.onmicrosoft.com`. - *Accounts in any organizational directory* (multi-tenant): set `MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID` to `organizations`. - *... and personal Microsoft accounts*: set `MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID` to `common` (work, school and personal accounts) or `consumers` (personal accounts only). The value must match the app's account type, otherwise Microsoft refuses the sign-in (AADSTS50194 or AADSTS50020). 3. Under **Redirect URI** pick platform **Web** and enter `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud, or `/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself. It must match character for character (AADSTS50011 otherwise). 4. **API permissions → Add a permission → Microsoft Graph → Delegated permissions**: add `offline_access`, `User.Read`, `Notes.ReadWrite`. 5. **Certificates & secrets → New client secret**. Copy the secret **Value** (not the Secret ID); it is shown once. Note its expiry date: when it expires the connector stops working until you paste a new one. 6. Paste the **Application (client) ID** into `MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`, the secret value into `MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET`, the tenant value from step 2 into `MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID`, and install. 7. On the connector page click **Authorize with Provider** and sign in with the account whose notebooks the AI should work with. The refresh token is stored encrypted and access tokens (about 1 hour) are renewed automatically. **One Entra app for all Microsoft connectors**: the app registration made for the Outlook connector works here as well. Open it, add the delegated permissions from step 4 under **API permissions**, keep the same redirect URI, and reuse the same `MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID`, `MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET` and `MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID`. Each connector asks only for its own scopes when you authorize it. The permissions per connector: - Outlook: `Mail.ReadWrite`, `Mail.Send`, `Calendars.ReadWrite` - OneDrive: `Files.ReadWrite` - Excel: `Files.ReadWrite` (plus `Files.ReadWrite.All` for workbooks in SharePoint or shared with the user) - SharePoint: `Sites.ReadWrite.All` and `Files.ReadWrite.All` - OneNote: `Notes.ReadWrite` - Microsoft To Do: `Tasks.ReadWrite` - Planner: `Tasks.ReadWrite` Every connector also needs `offline_access` and `User.Read`. **Admin consent**: these delegated permissions normally do not need an administrator, but many organisations turn off user consent. If the sign-in shows "Need admin approval" (AADSTS65001 or AADSTS90094), a tenant administrator opens the app registration → **API permissions → Grant admin consent for ** once; afterwards every user can authorize. Each connector still works only with what the account that signed in may see. **Scopes**: `offline_access User.Read Notes.ReadWrite`. `offline_access` is what makes Microsoft issue a refresh token; without it the connector stops an hour after authorizing. `Notes.ReadWrite` covers the user's own notebooks. For notebooks other people shared with the user (work or school), add `Notes.ReadWrite.All` to the app registration, replace `Notes.ReadWrite` with it in the connector's OAuth settings and authorize again. For a read-only setup, use `offline_access User.Read Notes.Read`, authorize again, and disable `microsoft_onenote_create_notebook`, `microsoft_onenote_create_section`, `microsoft_onenote_create_page`, `microsoft_onenote_append_to_page` and `microsoft_onenote_update_page`. **Confirm writes**: before creating a notebook, section or page, or changing a page, tell the user what you are about to write and where, and wait for a yes. **Switched off at install**: `microsoft_onenote_delete_page`. Turn it on per tool only if the AI should delete pages. **Structure**: notebook → section groups (optional folders, can nest) → sections → pages. Find a notebook with `microsoft_onenote_list_notebooks`, its sections with `microsoft_onenote_list_notebook_sections` (sections inside section groups with `microsoft_onenote_list_notebook_section_groups` and `microsoft_onenote_list_section_group_sections`), or all sections at once with `microsoft_onenote_list_sections`. Then `microsoft_onenote_list_section_pages` lists a section's pages. **Finding pages**: `microsoft_onenote_list_pages` lists pages across notebooks, newest change first. Search titles with `filter` = `contains(tolower(title),'budget')`; filter on `lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-09-01` for recent pages. Graph does not search page text; open candidate pages with `microsoft_onenote_get_page_content`. Users with very many OneNote items get error 10008 from `microsoft_onenote_list_pages`; go section by section then. **Reading**: `microsoft_onenote_get_page_content` returns the page as HTML. Read the text from it and leave the markup out of your answer. Images appear as links to Graph resources that only open with the user's sign-in; ink drawings are not included. Very long pages are cut off at about 200 KB. **Writing** - `microsoft_onenote_create_page` builds the page from a `title` and `body_html`. Use well-formed HTML (close every tag, write `&` as `&`). `

Call Anna

` makes a checkbox; `` pulls a public image into the page. Uploading files or images from the user's computer is not supported here. - `microsoft_onenote_append_to_page` adds HTML at the end of a page: the easy way to add notes. - `microsoft_onenote_update_page` sends change commands: replace the title (`{"target":"title","action":"replace","content":"New title"}`), insert next to or replace an element. To replace an element, read the page with `include_ids` true and use the element's generated `id` (e.g. `p:{33f8a242-...}{40}`, no `#`). Ids change after each update; read again before the next change. - Writes that succeed return no content (HTTP 204) for updates and the new object (HTTP 201) for creates. **Pagination**: list answers carry `@odata.nextLink` while more results exist. Call the same tool again with `skip` set to the `$skip` value in that link (and the same `top`). Pages come 20 at a time unless `top` (at most 100) says otherwise. **Rate limits**: Microsoft Graph throttles OneNote per user and per app. A throttled call answers 429 with Retry-After; wait and retry. **Common errors** - 401 `InvalidAuthenticationToken`: the authorization was revoked or the client secret expired. Paste a new secret if needed and click **Authorize with Provider** again. - 403 (code 40004 or 40002): `Notes.ReadWrite` is missing or not consented, or the notebook is shared read-only with the user. - 404 or code 20102/20112: the id is wrong or the item was deleted. - 20117: a notebook or section with that name already exists there. 20115/20153/20155: the name has a forbidden character or is too long (notebooks 128, sections 50 characters). - 20120, 20134 or 20149: the update command's target was not found; read the page again with `include_ids` true. 20121/20122/20141: the action does not fit the target (for example a replace on a `data-id` paragraph). - 10008 or 20266 on `microsoft_onenote_list_pages`: too many OneNote items for a cross-notebook query; list per section. - 30105/30108: the user's OneDrive for Business is not set up yet; the user opens OneDrive once, or the admin checks the licence. **Out of scope here**: uploading images or files into pages, ink, page previews, copying pages or sections, and notebooks of groups or SharePoint sites.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.label: Application (client) ID
MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.help: Microsoft Entra admin center → App registrations → your app → Overview: Application (client) ID. The app registration made for the Outlook connector works here too.
MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: The Application (client) ID is a GUID like 00001111-aaaa-2222-bbbb-3333cccc4444.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client secret value
MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Same app → Certificates & secrets → New client secret: copy the Value column (shown once), not the Secret ID.

MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID.label: Tenant
MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID.help: Single-tenant app: the Directory (tenant) ID from the app's Overview page (or your domain, e.g. contoso.onmicrosoft.com). Multi-tenant app: organizations. App that also accepts personal accounts: common (or consumers for personal accounts only).
MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID.patternMessage: Use a tenant GUID, a verified domain such as contoso.onmicrosoft.com, or one of common, organizations, consumers.

verifyHints.401: Microsoft refused the access token. Click Authorize with Provider again; if the client secret has expired, create a new one in the app registration first.
verifyHints.403: The app lacks a Graph permission or consent for it. Add Notes.ReadWrite and User.Read as delegated permissions, grant admin consent if your organisation requires it, and authorize again.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Microsoft Graph is throttling OneNote for this account. Wait a minute and try again.

prerequisites: An app registration in Microsoft Entra (free, about 10 minutes) with the redirect URI below, the delegated Graph permissions `offline_access`, `User.Read` and `Notes.ReadWrite`, and a client secret. The app registration of the Outlook connector can be reused: add the permission to it. Some organisations only let an admin grant consent.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_list_notebooks
tools.description: List the OneNote notebooks the user can open: id, displayName, isDefault, isShared, userRole (Owner, Contributor, Reader), dates and links (oneNoteWebUrl opens the notebook in the browser). Sorted by name. Start here to find a notebook id.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. "contains(tolower(displayName),'project')" or "lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-01-01". Property names are case-sensitive; compare text with tolower().

top.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

skip.description: How many to skip, for the next page: the $skip value from @odata.nextLink.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_list_sections
tools.description: List all sections in all of the user's notebooks, including sections inside section groups. Each has id, displayName, isDefault, dates, links, and its parentNotebook and parentSectionGroup (id, displayName). Use filter to narrow, e.g. by name.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. "contains(tolower(displayName),'project')" or "lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-01-01". Property names are case-sensitive; compare text with tolower().

top.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

skip.description: How many to skip, for the next page: the $skip value from @odata.nextLink.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_list_notebook_sections
tools.description: List the sections directly inside one notebook (not those inside its section groups; see microsoft_onenote_list_notebook_section_groups). Returns id, displayName, isDefault, dates and links.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. "contains(tolower(displayName),'project')" or "lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-01-01". Property names are case-sensitive; compare text with tolower().

top.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

skip.description: How many to skip, for the next page: the $skip value from @odata.nextLink.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_list_section_groups
tools.description: List all section groups (folders of sections) in the user's notebooks, including nested ones. Each has id, displayName, parentNotebook and parentSectionGroup.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. "contains(tolower(displayName),'project')" or "lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-01-01". Property names are case-sensitive; compare text with tolower().

top.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

skip.description: How many to skip, for the next page: the $skip value from @odata.nextLink.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_list_notebook_section_groups
tools.description: List the section groups directly inside one notebook: id, displayName, dates and links. Their sections come from microsoft_onenote_list_section_group_sections.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. "contains(tolower(displayName),'project')" or "lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-01-01". Property names are case-sensitive; compare text with tolower().

top.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

skip.description: How many to skip, for the next page: the $skip value from @odata.nextLink.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_list_section_group_sections
tools.description: List the sections directly inside one section group: id, displayName, isDefault, dates and links.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. "contains(tolower(displayName),'project')" or "lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-01-01". Property names are case-sensitive; compare text with tolower().

top.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

skip.description: How many to skip, for the next page: the $skip value from @odata.nextLink.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_list_pages
tools.description: List pages across all of the user's notebooks, most recently changed first: id, title, createdDateTime, lastModifiedDateTime, links (oneNoteWebUrl) and parentSection. Search page titles with filter "contains(tolower(title),'word')". Page text is not searchable here; read it with microsoft_onenote_get_page_content. When the user has very many OneNote items this call can fail (error 10008); list the pages of one section with microsoft_onenote_list_section_pages instead.

filter.description: OData filter on page properties, e.g. "contains(tolower(title),'meeting')" to search titles, "lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-09-01", or "parentNotebook/id eq '<notebook id>'". Property names are case-sensitive; compare text with tolower().

orderby.description: Sort order, e.g. "title" or "createdDateTime desc". Default: lastModifiedDateTime desc (most recently changed first).

top.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

skip.description: How many to skip, for the next page: the $skip value from @odata.nextLink.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_list_section_pages
tools.description: List the pages of one section: id, title, dates, links. With page_level true each page also carries level (indentation, 0 for top-level pages) and order (position in the section).

section_id.description: Section id from microsoft_onenote_list_sections or microsoft_onenote_list_notebook_sections.

filter.description: OData filter on page properties, e.g. "contains(tolower(title),'meeting')" to search titles, "lastModifiedDateTime ge 2026-09-01", or "parentNotebook/id eq '<notebook id>'". Property names are case-sensitive; compare text with tolower().

orderby.description: Sort order, e.g. "title" or "createdDateTime desc". Default: lastModifiedDateTime desc (most recently changed first).

top.description: How many to return (default 20, at most 100).

skip.description: How many to skip, for the next page: the $skip value from @odata.nextLink.

page_level.description: Also return each page's level and order within the section.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_get_page
tools.description: Get one page's metadata: title, dates, links, contentUrl, and the parentSection and parentNotebook it belongs to. For the text, use microsoft_onenote_get_page_content.

page_id.description: Page id from microsoft_onenote_list_pages or microsoft_onenote_list_section_pages.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_get_page_content
tools.description: Read a page: OneNote returns the page as HTML (title in , text in <p>, <li>, <table> elements inside absolutely positioned <div>s; images as <img> links to Graph that need the user's sign-in to open). Answers larger than about 200 KB are cut off with a note. Set include_ids to true before editing with microsoft_onenote_update_page: every element then carries the generated id that update commands target.

page_id.description: Page id from microsoft_onenote_list_pages or microsoft_onenote_list_section_pages.

include_ids.description: Add the generated id of every element (needed to target paragraphs, lists and tables with microsoft_onenote_update_page).

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_create_notebook
tools.description: Create a new notebook in the user's OneDrive. Returns the notebook with id and links. Confirm with the user before calling.

display_name.description: Notebook name, unique among the user's notebooks, at most 128 characters, without ? * / : < > | ' ".

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_create_section
tools.description: Create a section in a notebook. Returns the section with id, which microsoft_onenote_create_page needs. Confirm with the user before calling.

display_name.description: Section name, unique in the notebook, at most 50 characters, without ? * \ / : < > | & # ' " % ~.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_create_page
tools.description:
Create a page in a section from a title and HTML content. Use simple HTML:

,

-

, , ,
    /
      /
    1. , , , (a public image URL), and

      for a checkbox. Returns the new page with id and links (oneNoteWebUrl). Confirm with the user before calling.

section_id.description: Section id from microsoft_onenote_list_sections or microsoft_onenote_list_notebook_sections.

title.description: Page title, plain text. Write & as & and < as <.

body_html.description:
The page content as HTML elements (what goes inside ), e.g. "

Agenda

  • Budget
". Must be well-formed: close every tag, write & as &.

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_append_to_page
tools.description:
Add HTML at the end of a page (inside its first div), e.g. "

Follow-up: call Anna on Friday

". The simplest way to add notes to an existing page. OneNote answers with no content when it worked. Confirm with the user before calling.

page_id.description: Page id from microsoft_onenote_list_pages or microsoft_onenote_list_section_pages.

html.description:
Well-formed HTML to append, e.g. "

New paragraph

" or "
  • Item
".

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_update_page
tools.description: Change a page with a list of commands, each {target, action, position?, content}. target: "title" (only action replace, content = new title text), "body" (the first div; append or prepend), "#data-id" (an id you set with data-id when writing), or a generated id from microsoft_onenote_get_page_content with include_ids true, e.g. "p:{33f8a242-...}{40}" (without #). action: append (as last child, or first with position before; for body, div, ol, ul), prepend, insert (as sibling, position after or before), replace (needs the generated id, except for title). Generated ids change after an update, so read the page again before the next one. OneNote answers with no content when it worked. Confirm with the user before calling.

page_id.description: Page id from microsoft_onenote_list_pages or microsoft_onenote_list_section_pages.

commands.description:
The changes, applied in order, e.g. [{"target":"title","action":"replace","content":"Q4 planning"},{"target":"p:{33f8a242-7c33-4bb2-90c5-8425a68cc5bf}{40}","action":"replace","content":"

Updated text

"}].

target.description: title, body, #data-id or a generated id.

position.description: For append and insert; default after.

content.description: Well-formed HTML (plain text for the title).

tools.name: microsoft_onenote_delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page. This connector cannot undo it. Installed switched off. Confirm with the user before calling.

page_id.description: Page id from microsoft_onenote_list_pages or microsoft_onenote_list_section_pages.
